text: Yes, deforestation occurred on the asset in 2023. Satellite data detected tree-cover loss of approximately 0.7 hectares (1.2% of the 58.1-ha asset) during that year. This loss was confirmed by multiple sources, including the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset and JRC Global Forest Cover 2020, which agreed on the event area. The change was primarily in planted forest (Eucalyptus species), not native forest. However, the cause (e.g., logging, fire, or other disturbances) and legality of the change cannot be determined from this evidence alone.
